description: Offline class-group, ideal-map, unit-group, and regulator corpus. Polynomial coefficients are ascending decimal integers.

canonicalization.rationals: one positive common denominator and decimal-string numerators
canonicalization.sage_ideal_hnf: PARI HNF in Sage's maximal-order integral basis
canonicalization.magma_ideal_hnf: row BasisMatrix in Magma's maximal-order integral basis
canonicalization.class_logs: coordinates in the recorded oracle-specific class-group generators
canonicalization.regulators: closed decimal endpoint intervals from a weighted archimedean logarithm determinant; complex places have weight two

known_hard_cases.ordinary_harness_policy: metadata-only; exclude the expensive unconditional pass from all and stress tiers

recommended_acceptance_thresholds.correctness: all stable exact fields and proof-mode answers match; every ideal log, principality result, generator-order relation, and unit norm replays
recommended_acceptance_thresholds.policy: directional integration thresholds; ratchet only from uncontended five-sample Sage.js measurements

oracle_baseline.timing_policy: historical one-sample context; ignored by stable --check

hecke_oscar.reason: Julia is not installed on the capture host; Hecke remains an optional third family and is not counted as agreement
